content.description:
In the realm of Cardania, where chaos reigns, the Paxies emerged as symbols of hope. Warriors forged unbreakable bonds with these pixel-art companions, venturing into the unknown to battle fierce enemies. But darkness looms, threatening their very existence. Paximus,a mighty warrior, seeks to unlock the power of breeding, but time is running out. Will they conquer the abyss or be lost to history forever?

A lot of work is already behind us. But as a Paxie holder, you deserve the best of the best. And we're dedicated to bringing you exclusive Cardano experiences.

Join us and own a piece of history!
content.meta: Find out about Paxies on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions. Get immediate access to the project Website, Social Media, Whitepaper and Token distribution.
